about_the_game:
Beat up Aliens with your Vampire Friends or Solo with plenty of weapons, abilities and minions to resurrect! Absorb the blood of your enemies to recover health and level up your Vampire powers as you fight through hoards of Alien runts and Bosses. Find and take eggs back to your home area to raise bats that raise your stats!

Story Mode

Go through the 10 Level Campaign solo or with friends with a whole lot of beat em up action, chests to find and unlock, secrets to discover and plenty of bugs to feed to your bats!

Level up your characters Individual stats

Level up your individual characters and put up their stats in any order to make yourself stronger, faster, healthier and even more magical than ever before!

Many Combat / Magic Abilities to unlock!

Abilities are unlocked when you reach certain milestones for your character, these include new combo attacks for fighters, Blood magic for the spellcasters, Dashing and gliding for the speed freaks and health regen and increases for the Healthy vampires out there!

Absorb blood to regain HP

Regenerate lost health by absorbing the blood from enemies, meat piles and well, anything that bleeds really!

Raise bats to raise your stats!

Find eggs throughout your playthrough and hatch them at the bat house. A random bat ranging in level and looks will be hatched and if you bring them along, they will give you stat upgrades as long as they are with you!

A big arsenal of weapons and utilities

Some weapons include Whips, guns boomerangs, yoyo, throwing axes, summons and more!

There are also utilities to help you along the way such as trampoline brain, UFO skateboard, helium balloons and more!

Unlockable characters!

Unlock characters with different starting weapons and new looks by doing certain in game tasks like treasure hunts and completing the game!

Multiplayer

Play with up to 4 players Online and Locally!

Crazy Alien Bosses

ISOR THE INVADER? SNEEZO THE MECHANIC?!?! Now those are some pretty wacky Aliens!

Secret areas and challenges to find

Hey you, yes you! You like secrets? 👀 well we got em!
Discover secret areas and get through the challenges to be rewarded greatly!

Original Soundtrack

Gracenote studios + Rudeface rocked out this original dynamic soundtrack!

Hand drawn animated Animations and Art

Hand drawn textures and animations drawn on a graphics tablet!

3D world to explore with 2D characters

Interesting 3D environments with lots to explore and find round every corner. Navigated by 2D Aliens, vampires and creatures alike!

Fancy Hats!

Plenty of cosmetic hats to add a unique look and to keep your head warm!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some cartoon violence, gore and blood.
